facts.fact: INTIC board chairman Lourino Chemane said at a Maputo roundtable that Mozambique does not yet have specific legislation governing artificial intelligence; he called for a dedicated AI legal framework and mentioned only a planned proposal for an Online Copyright Protection Act next year, with no AI draft named.

INTIC board chairman Lourino Chemane said Mozambique has no specific legislation governing artificial intelligence and needs a dedicated legal framework for AI; the document names no AI law of general reach.
